examples.chinese: 你要喝什麼？咖啡還是茶？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào hē shénme? Kāfēi háishì chá?
examples.english: What do you want to drink? Coffee or tea?

examples.chinese: 好啊！你想喝什麼？咖啡還是茶？
examples.pinyin: Hǎo a! Nǐ xiǎng hē shénme? Kāfēi háishì chá?
examples.english: Okay! What would you like to drink? Coffee or tea?

examples.chinese: 你要果汁還是牛奶？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào guǒzhī háishì niúnǎi?
examples.english: Do you want juice or milk?

examples.chinese: 請問兩位要紅茶還是綠茶？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn liǎng wèi yào hóngchá háishì lǜchá?
examples.english: Would you like to have black tea or green tea?

examples.chinese: 你喜歡山上的風景還是海邊的風景？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuān shānshàng de fēngjǐng háishì hǎibiān de fēngjǐng?
examples.english: Do you like the scenery on the mountain or on the beach?

examples.chinese: 你想坐捷運去，還是坐公車去？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng zuò jiéyùn qù, háishì zuò gōngchē qù?
examples.english: Do you want to take the MRT, or take the bus?

examples.chinese: 你想坐捷運去，還是坐公車去？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng zuò jiéyùn qù, háishì zuò gōngchē qù?
examples.english: Do you want to take the MRT, or take the bus?

examples.chinese: 你想坐捷運去，還是坐公車去？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng zuò jiéyùn qù, háishì zuò gōngchē qù?
examples.english: Do you want to take the MRT, or take the bus?

examples.chinese: 在你的國家，成年的孩子常跟父母住在一起，還是滿十八歲就搬出去了？
examples.pinyin: Zài nǐ de guójiā, chéngnián de háizi cháng gēn fùmǔ zhù zài yīqǐ, háishì mǎn shíbā suì jiù bān chūqù le?
examples.english: In your country, do children who have become adults often live with their parents, or do they move out as soon as they turn eighteen?

examples.chinese: 在我爺爺奶奶的年代，生活比較辛苦，不少窮人為了省錢，衣服破了還是繼續穿。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒ yéye nǎinai de niándài, shēnghuó bǐjiào xīnkǔ, bùshǎo qióngrén wèile shěng qián, yīfu pò le háishì jìxù chuān.
examples.english: In my grandparents' era, life was relatively hard; many poor people, in order to save money, continued to wear clothes even after they were torn.

examples.chinese: 李老闆是個很實在的人，他賣的包子不但好吃，餡料（xiànliào， filling）也很實在，難怪生意好得不得了。今天天氣實在太熱了，雖然夏天的電費很貴，我還是把冷氣打開了。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ lǎobǎn shì ge hěn shízài de rén, tā mài de bāozi búdàn hǎochī, xiànliào yě hěn shízài, nánguài shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo. Jīntiān tiānqì shízài tài rè le, suīrán xiàtiān de diànfèi hěn guì, wǒ háishì bǎ lěngqì dǎkāi le.
examples.english: Boss Li is a very honest person; the steamed buns he sells are not only delicious, but the filling is also very generous—no wonder his business is incredibly good. Today the weather is really too hot; although summer electricity bills are expensive, I still turned on the air conditioner.

examples.chinese: 從這裡走路回家有一點兒距離，而且現在還下著大雨，我們還是搭計程車算了。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ zǒulù huí jiā yǒu yīdiǎnr jùlí, érqiě xiànzài hái xiàzhe dàyǔ, wǒmen háishì dā jìchéngchē suàn le.
examples.english: Walking home from here is a bit of a distance, and it's still raining heavily now, so we might as well take a taxi.

examples.chinese: A:這個玩具雖然可愛，但是不適合送給剛滿月的孩子，我們還是送紅包吧！ B:也好。送紅包也不錯。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhège wánjù suīrán kě'ài, dànshì bù shìhé sòng gěi gāng mǎn yuè de háizi, wǒmen háishì sòng hóngbāo ba! B: Yě hǎo. Sòng hóngbāo yě bùcuò.
examples.english: A: Although this toy is cute, it's not suitable to give to a child who has just turned one month old; we might as well give a red envelope! B: That's fine. Giving a red envelope is also good.

examples.chinese: 前面發生了交通意外，為了避免被困在路上，我們還是走別條路吧。
examples.pinyin: Qiánmiàn fāshēng le jiāotōng yìwài, wèile bìmiǎn bèi kùn zài lùshàng, wǒmen háishì zǒu bié tiáo lù ba.
examples.english: There was a traffic accident ahead; to avoid being stuck on the road, we should take another route.

examples.chinese: 我本來打算下星期騎車環島，但是颱風剛過，想來想去，還是決定不去了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái dǎsuàn xià xīngqī qíchē huándǎo, dànshì táifēng gāng guò, xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, háishì juédìng bù qù le.
examples.english: I originally planned to go around the island by bike next week, but the typhoon just passed, and after thinking it over, I decided not to go after all.

examples.chinese: 一般人認為，名牌商品不僅價格高，品質標準也比較高。「先有雞還是先有蛋」，這個問題有標準答案嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yìbān rén rènwéi, míngpái shāngpǐn bùjǐn jiàgé gāo, pǐnzhì biāozhǔn yě bǐjiào gāo. “Xiān yǒu jī háishì xiān yǒu dàn”, zhège wèntí yǒu biāozhǔn dá'àn ma?
examples.english: Most people think that brand-name products are not only high in price, but their quality standard is also relatively high. “Which came first, the chicken or the egg?” Does this question have a standard answer?

examples.chinese: 商先生從不發脾氣，人也很謙虛，不論別人怎麼批評他，他還是很客氣地說謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Shāng xiānshēng cóng bù fā píqi, rén yě hěn qiānxū, bùlùn biérén zěnme pīpíng tā, tā háishi hěn kèqi de shuō xièxie.
examples.english: Mr. Shang never loses his temper and is also very modest; no matter how others criticize him, he still politely says thank you.

examples.chinese: 史小姐做事很細心，這張表我檢查過好幾次，還是被她發現了幾個錯字。
examples.pinyin: Shǐ xiǎojiě zuòshì hěn xìxīn, zhè zhāng biǎo wǒ jiǎnchá guo hǎojǐ cì, háishi bèi tā fāxiàn le jǐ ge cuòzì.
examples.english: Ms. Shi is very careful in her work; I checked this form several times, but she still found a few typos.

examples.chinese: 儘管這次推銷新產品的活動辦得很順利，顧客的反應也很好，不過還是有需要改進的地方。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè cì tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de huódòng bàn de hěn shùnlì, gùkè de fǎnyìng yě hěn hǎo, bùguò háishì yǒu xūyào gǎijìn de dìfāng.
examples.english: Although this event to promote the new product went very smoothly and customers' reactions were also very good, there are still areas that need improvement.

examples.chinese: 理論上，有空氣、水、食物就可以維持生命，但還是得看實際的情況。著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Lǐlùn shàng, yǒu kōngqì, shuǐ, shíwù jiù kěyǐ wéichí shēngmìng, dàn háishì děi kàn shíjì de qíngkuàng. Zhùmíng de kēxuéjiā Àiyīnsītǎn fāmíng le xiāngduìlùn, zhège lǐlùn duì hòulái de kēxué yánjiū chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: In theory, with air, water, and food, life can be maintained, but it still depends on the actual situation. The famous scientist Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity; this theory had a major impact on later scientific research.

examples.chinese: 我們要怎麼去？坐捷運還是坐公車？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zěnme qù? Zuò jiéyùn háishì zuò gōngchē?
examples.english: How do we get there? By MRT or bus?

examples.chinese: 我家附近有百貨公司，你想去看嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu bǎihuò gōngsī, nǐ xiǎng qù kàn ma?
examples.english: There is a department store near my home; do you want to go take a look?

examples.chinese: 知道，百貨公司都有，不難找。
examples.pinyin: Zhīdào, bǎihuògōngsī dōu yǒu, bù nán zhǎo.
examples.english: Yes. I think you can get them in department stores; it is not too difficult to find.

examples.chinese: 女生和男生都喜歡去百貨公司買東西。
examples.pinyin: Nǚshēng hé nánshēng dōu xǐhuān qù bǎihuò gōngsī mǎi dōngxi.
examples.english: Both girls and boys like to go to the department store to shop.

examples.chinese: 鞋子都在一樓，我們到樓下去吧！九點了，百貨公司快要關了。
examples.pinyin: Xiézi dōu zài yì lóu, wǒmen dào lóuxià qù ba! Jiǔ diǎn le, bǎihuògōngsī kuàiyào guān le.
examples.english: All the shoes are on the first floor. Let’s go downstairs. It’s 9:00; the department store is closing soon.

examples.chinese: 百貨公司裡有很多衣服、鞋子和皮包，都是最新的，所以很多年輕女生喜歡到百貨公司去，漂亮的、流行的衣服，她們都想穿穿看。
examples.pinyin: Bǎihuògōngsī lǐ yǒu hěn duō yīfu, xiézi hé píbāo, dōu shì zuì xīn de, suǒyǐ hěn duō niánqīng nǚshēng xǐhuān dào bǎihuògōngsī qù, piàoliang de, liúxíng de yīfu, tāmen dōu xiǎng chuānchuān kàn.
examples.english: Clothes, shoes and purses in department stores are all the latest; therefore, many young ladies like to go there and try on both beautiful and trendy items.

examples.chinese: 我媽媽的花店在百貨公司和超級市場中間。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma de huādiàn zài bǎihuò gōngsī hé chāojí shìchǎng zhōngjiān.
examples.english: My mother's flower shop is between the department store and the supermarket.

examples.chinese: 那家新的百貨公司離這裡遠嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā xīn de bǎihuò gōngsī lí zhèlǐ yuǎn ma?
examples.english: Is that new department store far from here?

examples.chinese: 這雙球鞋的設計很特別，在百貨公司的專櫃才買得到。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shuāng qiúxié de shèjì hěn tèbié, zài bǎihuò gōngsī de zhuānguì cái mǎi de dào.
examples.english: The design of this pair of sneakers is very special; you can only buy them at the brand counter in a department store.

examples.chinese: 付錢的時候，他從皮包裡抽出一張信用卡交給店員。他參加百貨公司的活動，抽到一台價格六萬元的平板電腦， 真是太幸運了！
examples.pinyin: Fù qián de shíhou, tā cóng píbāo lǐ chōu chū yī zhāng xìnyòngkǎ jiāo gěi diànyuán. Tā cānjiā bǎihuò gōngsī de huódòng, chōu dào yī tái jiàgé liù wàn yuán de píngbǎn diànnǎo, zhēn shì tài xìngyùn le!
examples.english: When paying, he took out a credit card from his wallet and handed it to the clerk. He participated in a department store event and drew a tablet computer worth 60,000 yuan; he was really so lucky!

examples.chinese: 這個牌子的運動服在夜市賣五百元，可是在百貨公司賣兩千元，你覺得合理嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhège páizi de yùndòngfú zài yèshì mài wǔbǎi yuán, kěshì zài bǎihuò gōngsī mài liǎngqiān yuán, nǐ juéde hélǐ ma?
examples.english: This brand of sportswear sells for five hundred yuan at the night market, but sells for two thousand yuan at the department store—do you think that's reasonable?

examples.chinese: 我要坐電梯，不要走樓梯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào zuò diàntī, bù yào zǒu lóutī.
examples.english: I want to take the elevator, not walk the stairs.

examples.chinese: 電梯在那裡！我們現在去買。
examples.pinyin: Diàntī zài nàlǐ! Wǒmen xiànzài qù mǎi.
examples.english: There is the elevator! Let’s go get them now.

items.wordHook: 電(electricity) + 梯(ladder): an electric ladder that carries people between floors → an elevator.

examples.chinese: 強烈的陽光對我們的眼睛不好，出門活動時最好戴上太陽眼鏡。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè de yángguāng duì wǒmen de yǎnjing bù hǎo, chūmén huódòng shí zuìhǎo dài shàng tàiyáng yǎnjìng.
examples.english: Strong sunlight is bad for our eyes; when going out for activities, it's best to wear sunglasses.

examples.chinese: 在冬天，臺灣南部比北部暖和，你可以到南部享受暖暖的陽光。
examples.pinyin: Zài dōngtiān, Táiwān nánbù bǐ běibù nuǎnhuo, nǐ kěyǐ dào nánbù xiǎngshòu nuǎnnuǎn de yángguāng.
examples.english: In winter, southern Taiwan is warmer than the north; you can go to the south to enjoy the warm sunshine.

examples.chinese: 假如缺乏陽光、空氣和水這三項條件，植物就無法生長。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú quēfá yángguāng, kōngqì hé shuǐ zhè sān xiàng tiáojiàn, zhíwù jiù wúfǎ shēngzhǎng.
examples.english: If plants lack the three conditions of sunlight, air, and water, they cannot grow.

examples.chinese: 我昨天割草時沒戴帽子，整張臉都因為陽光太強而變紅了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān gē cǎo shí méi dài màozi, zhěng zhāng liǎn dōu yīnwèi yángguāng tài qiáng ér biàn hóng le.
examples.english: When I mowed the lawn yesterday, I didn't wear a hat, and my whole face turned red because the sunlight was too strong.

examples.chinese: 夏天一到，就有不少遊客到海灘，光著身體享受陽光與海風。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān yí dào, jiù yǒu bùshǎo yóukè dào hǎitān, guāngzhe shēntǐ xiǎngshòu yángguāng yǔ hǎifēng.
examples.english: As soon as summer arrives, many tourists go to the beach, baring their bodies and enjoying the sunshine and sea breeze.

examples.chinese: 我生病了，媽媽今天要帶我去醫院看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shēngbìng le, māma jīntiān yào dài wǒ qù yīyuàn kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: I got sick; my mom is going to take me to the hospital to see a doctor today.

examples.chinese: 他上個禮拜生病了，現在還在咳嗽。
examples.pinyin: Tā shàng ge lǐbài shēngbìng le, xiànzài hái zài késou.
examples.english: He got sick last week, and he is still coughing now.

examples.chinese: A:聽說你弟弟生病了，他現在怎麼樣？ B:他好了，明天可以去學校了。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō nǐ dìdi shēngbìng le, tā xiànzài zěnmeyàng? B: Tā hǎo le, míngtiān kěyǐ qù xuéxiào le.
examples.english: A: I heard your younger brother got sick; how is he now? B: He has gotten well; he can go to school tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸很健康，不常生病。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba hěn jiànkāng, bù cháng shēngbìng.
examples.english: My dad is very healthy and doesn't often get sick.

examples.chinese: 老師，我很健康，不常生病。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī, wǒ hěn jiànkāng, bù cháng shēngbìng.
examples.english: I am healthy and seldom get sick, teacher.

examples.chinese: 平常不生病的人也要注意。
examples.pinyin: Píngcháng bù shēngbìng de rén yě yào zhùyì.
examples.english: People who don’t get sick often should pay attention to their health as well.

examples.chinese: A:醫生說我應該多運動，少吃太鹹、太油的東西，這樣才不容易生病。 B:就是說嘛！我跟你說過好多次了，你怎麼不聽呢？
examples.pinyin: A: Yīshēng shuō wǒ yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tài xián, tài yóu de dōngxi, zhèyàng cái bù róngyì shēngbìng. B: Jiùshì shuō ma! Wǒ gēn nǐ shuō guò hǎo duō cì le, nǐ zěnme bù tīng ne?
examples.english: A: The doctor said I should exercise more and eat less of things that are too salty or too oily; this way it's not easy to get sick. B: Exactly! I've told you many times, why don't you listen?

examples.chinese: 醫生說那個病人得住院，要是三天以內都沒發燒、頭也不痛了，就可以出院了。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō nàge bìngrén děi zhùyuàn, yàoshi sān tiān yǐnèi dōu méi fāshāo, tóu yě bú tòng le, jiù kěyǐ chūyuàn le.
examples.english: The doctor said that patient has to be hospitalized; if within three days he has no fever and his head no longer hurts, then he can be discharged.

examples.chinese: 有一些病人不肯乖乖吃藥，護理師得有耐心，慢慢地跟他們講道理。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē bìngrén bù kěn guāiguāi chī yào, hùlǐshī děi yǒu nàixīn, mànman de gēn tāmen jiǎng dàolǐ.
examples.english: Some patients refuse to take their medicine obediently, so nurses must have patience and slowly reason with them.

examples.chinese: 醫生的工作是讓病人恢復健康，甚至把寶貴的生命救回來，所以我們應該尊敬醫生。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng de gōngzuò shì ràng bìngrén huīfù jiànkāng, shènzhì bǎ bǎoguì de shēngmìng jiù huílái, suǒyǐ wǒmen yīnggāi zūnjìng yīshēng.
examples.english: A doctor's job is to help patients recover their health, and even to save precious life back, so we should respect doctors.

examples.chinese: 朋子看了好幾次醫生，吃了好幾個星期的藥，病總算好了。
examples.pinyin: Péngzǐ kàn le hǎo jǐ cì yīshēng, chī le hǎo jǐ gè xīngqī de yào, bìng zǒngsuàn hǎo le.
examples.english: Pengzi saw the doctor several times and took medicine for several weeks, and her illness finally got better.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，小感冒只要多喝水、多休息就行了，不需要看病、吃藥。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, xiǎo gǎnmào zhǐyào duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxi jiù xíng le, bù xūyào kànbìng, chī yào.
examples.english: Generally speaking, for a minor cold, you just need to drink more water and rest more; you don't need to see a doctor or take medicine.

examples.chinese: 小陳認為頭痛是小事，況且最近忙得連休息的時間都不夠，所以不肯去看病。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Chén rènwéi tóutòng shì xiǎoshì, kuàngqiě zuìjìn máng de lián xiūxi de shíjiān dōu bù gòu, suǒyǐ bù kěn qù kànbìng.
examples.english: Xiǎo Chén thinks a headache is a small matter; furthermore, recently he has been so busy that he doesn't even have enough time to rest, so he refuses to see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 我爺爺年紀大了，不但體力不好，還有頭痛、肩膀痛的毛病。我家的洗衣機用了二十多年了，毛病真不少，可是媽媽還不肯換新的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yéye niánjì dà le, bùdàn tǐlì bù hǎo, hái yǒu tóutòng, jiānbǎng tòng de máobìng. Wǒ jiā de xǐyījī yòng le èrshí duō nián le, máobìng zhēn bù shǎo, kěshì māma hái bù kěn huàn xīn de.
examples.english: My grandpa is old; not only is his physical strength poor, but he also has the problem of headaches and shoulder pain. Our washing machine has been used for over twenty years and has quite a few problems, but Mom still won't agree to replace it with a new one.

examples.chinese: A:小張病了三天了，不但全身沒力，還發高燒。 B:最近很多人都這樣，應該是感冒了。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiǎo Zhāng bìng le sān tiān le, bùdàn quánshēn méi lì, hái fā gāoshāo. B: Zuìjìn hěn duō rén dōu zhèyàng, yīnggāi shì gǎnmào le.
examples.english: A: Xiao Zhang has been ill for three days; not only does his whole body have no strength, but he also has a high fever. B: Many people have been like this recently; it's probably a cold.

examples.chinese: 陳先生身體一向挺健康的，沒想到一個小感冒就讓他病了一個多月。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiānshēng shēntǐ yīxiàng tǐng jiànkāng de, méi xiǎngdào yī gè xiǎo gǎnmào jiù ràng tā bìng le yī gè duō yuè.
examples.english: Mr. Chen has always been quite healthy; I never expected that a small cold would make him fall ill for over a month.

examples.chinese: 林伯伯覺得最近身體的毛病不少，可是說也奇怪，醫生檢查後都說他很正常。
examples.pinyin: Lín bóbo juéde zuìjìn shēntǐ de máobìng bù shǎo, kěshì shuō yě qíguài, yīshēng jiǎnchá hòu dōu shuō tā hěn zhèngcháng.
examples.english: Uncle Lin feels that he has quite a few health problems recently, but strange to say, after the doctor's examination, they all say he is very normal.

examples.chinese: 護理師告訴病人，得按三餐飯後的時間吃藥，才能快點恢復健康。
examples.pinyin: Hùlǐshī gàosu bìngrén, děi àn sāncān fànhòu de shíjiān chī yào, cái néng kuài diǎn huīfù jiànkāng.
examples.english: The nurse told the patient that he must take medicine according to the times after the three meals in order to recover his health quickly.

examples.chinese: 媽媽生病時，小華給家人做飯、照顧弟弟妹妹，真是個懂事的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Māma shēngbìng shí, Xiǎohuá gěi jiārén zuòfàn, zhàogù dìdì mèimei, zhēn shì ge dǒngshì de háizi.
examples.english: When Mom was sick, Xiaohua cooked for the family and took care of his younger brother and sister; he is truly a sensible child.

examples.chinese: 跟大人比起來，小孩子的想法比較單純、天真，不會故意騙人。A:網友跟我借十萬塊錢，說他的家人生病住院了。 B:你太天真了，他是騙你的。
examples.pinyin: 1. Gēn dàrén bǐ qǐlái, xiǎoháizi de xiǎngfǎ bǐjiào dānchún, tiānzhēn, bú huì gùyì piàn rén. 2. A: Wǎngyǒu gēn wǒ jiè shí wàn kuài qián, shuō tā de jiārén shēngbìng zhùyuàn le. B: Nǐ tài tiānzhēn le, tā shì piàn nǐ de.
examples.english: 1. Compared with adults, children's thinking is simpler and more innocent; they won't deliberately deceive people. 2. A: An online friend borrowed a hundred thousand dollars from me, saying his family member was sick and hospitalized. B: You're too naive; he's deceiving you.

examples.chinese: 天氣變涼了，奶奶頭痛的毛病又犯了。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì biàn liáng le, nǎinai tóutòng de máobìng yòu fàn le.
examples.english: The weather has turned cool, and Grandma's headache problem has occurred again.

examples.chinese: 有人以為身體沒什麼毛病就代表很健康，這樣的想法事實上不完全正確。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén yǐwéi shēntǐ méi shénme máobìng jiù dàibiǎo hěn jiànkāng, zhèyàng de xiǎngfǎ shìshíshàng bù wánquán zhèngquè.
examples.english: Some people think that if the body has no problems, it means being very healthy; in fact, this idea is not entirely correct.

items.wordHook: a 疒(sickness) takes hold on the 丙(third) floor → one bad case of 病(sickness).

examples.chinese: 這件大衣的設計很簡單，可是穿起來很好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn dàyī de shèjì hěn jiǎndān, kěshì chuān qǐlái hěn hǎokàn.
examples.english: The design of this coat is very simple, but it looks good when you put it on.

examples.chinese: A:謝謝你的幫助。沒有你的話， 我一個人很難完成新產品的廣告設計。 B:別這麼說。我們是同事，互相幫助是應該的。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù. Méiyǒu nǐ de huà, wǒ yīge rén hěn nán wánchéng xīn chǎnpǐn de guǎnggào shèjì. B: Bié zhème shuō. Wǒmen shì tóngshì, hùxiāng bāngzhù shì yīnggāi de.
examples.english: A: Thank you for your help. Without you, it would be very difficult for me to complete the advertising design for the new product alone. B: Don't say that. We are colleagues; helping each other is only right.

examples.chinese: 何小姐是一名模特兒，也會自己設計服裝，這幾張圖裡的裙子都是她畫的。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě shì yī míng mótè'ér, yě huì zìjǐ shèjì fúzhuāng, zhè jǐ zhāng tú lǐ de qúnzi dōu shì tā huà de.
examples.english: Miss He is a model and can also design clothes herself. The skirts in these pictures were all drawn by her.

examples.chinese: 那家廣告公司提供了五個工作機會，只要是設計系畢業的都可以去試試看。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā guǎnggào gōngsī tígōng le wǔ ge gōngzuò jīhuì, zhǐyào shì shèjì xì bìyè de dōu kěyǐ qù shìshi kàn.
examples.english: That advertising company provided five job opportunities; anyone who has graduated from a design department can go and give it a try.

examples.chinese: 這雙球鞋的設計很特別，在百貨公司的專櫃才買得到。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shuāng qiúxié de shèjì hěn tèbié, zài bǎihuò gōngsī de zhuānguì cái mǎi de dào.
examples.english: The design of this pair of sneakers is very special; you can only buy them at the brand counter in a department store.

examples.chinese: 這裡的每一樣產品都是老闆自己設計的，別的地方找不到相同的。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de měi yí yàng chǎnpǐn dōu shì lǎobǎn zìjǐ shèjì de, bié de dìfang zhǎo bú dào xiāngtóng de.
examples.english: Every kind of product here is designed by the owner himself; you can't find the same ones elsewhere.

examples.chinese: 為了符合市場的需求，「快時尚」公司不斷地設計出最流行的服裝樣式。
examples.pinyin: Wèile fúhé shìchǎng de xūqiú, “kuài shíshàng” gōngsī búduàn de shèjì chū zuì liúxíng de fúzhuāng yàngshì.
examples.english: In order to be in accord with market demand, “fast fashion” companies continuously design the most popular clothing styles.

examples.chinese: 現代各式各樣的科技產品，讓人們的生活更舒適、便利。這家旅館每個房間都設計得很現代，吸引不少年輕人來訂房。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài gè shì gè yàng de kējì chǎnpǐn, ràng rénmen de shēnghuó gèng shūshì, biànlì. Zhè jiā lǚguǎn měi gè fángjiān dōu shèjì de hěn xiàndài, xīyǐn bù shǎo niánqīngrén lái dìng fáng.
examples.english: Modern various technological products make people's lives more comfortable and convenient. This hotel's rooms are all designed in a very modern way, attracting many young people to book rooms.

examples.chinese: 有人設計出地震的警告系統，減少了地震帶來的傷害，這樣的成就真是了不起。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shèjì chū dìzhèn de jǐnggào xìtǒng, jiǎnshǎo le dìzhèn dàilái de shānghài, zhèyàng de chéngjiù zhēn shì liǎobuqǐ.
examples.english: Someone designed an earthquake warning system that reduced the damage caused by earthquakes; such an achievement is truly amazing.

examples.chinese: 這幾年由於市長積極實行交通建設計畫，使當地交通情況明顯改善了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ nián yóuyú shìzhǎng jījí shíxíng jiāotōng jiànshè jìhuà, shǐ dāngdì jiāotōng qíngkuàng míngxiǎn gǎishàn le.
examples.english: In recent years, because the mayor actively implemented a transportation construction plan, the local traffic situation has obviously improved.

examples.chinese: 那位服裝設計師相當喜愛十八世紀時的歐洲傳統風格。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi fúzhuāng shèjìshī xiāngdāng xǐ'ài shíbā shìjì shí de Ōuzhōu chuántǒng fēnggé.
examples.english: That fashion designer quite loves the traditional European style of the 18th century.

examples.chinese: 你把廣告設計得那麼小，這樣的宣傳怎麼有效果呢？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ guǎnggào shèjì de nàme xiǎo, zhèyàng de xuānchuán zěnme huì yǒu xiàoguǒ ne?
examples.english: You designed the advertisement so small; how could such promotion be effective?

examples.chinese: 工廠排水系統得設計好，以免汙染自然環境。
examples.pinyin: Gōngchǎng pái shuǐ xìtǒng děi shèjì hǎo, yǐmiǎn wūrǎn zìrán huánjìng.
examples.english: The factory's drainage system must be well designed, lest it pollute the natural environment.

examples.chinese: 離我家不遠的劇院，是請著名設計師來設計的。
examples.pinyin: Lí wǒ jiā bù yuǎn de jùyuàn, shì qǐng zhùmíng shèjìshī lái shèjì de.
examples.english: The theater not far from my home was designed by a famous designer.

examples.chinese: 那項新產品的設計圖你一個人負責太辛苦了，倒不如找同事一起來做。
examples.pinyin: Nà xiàng xīn chǎnpǐn de shèjìtú nǐ yī gè rén fùzé tài xīnkǔ le, dào bùrú zhǎo tóngshì yīqǐ lái zuò.
examples.english: It's too hard for you to be responsible for that new product's design drawings all by yourself; it would be better to find colleagues to do it together.

examples.chinese: 學校的布告欄總是隨著季節改變而有不同的設計。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de bùgàolán zǒngshì suízhe jìjié gǎibiàn ér yǒu bùtóng de shèjì.
examples.english: The school's bulletin board always has different designs as the seasons change.

examples.chinese: 戴小姐的父母對婚禮相當重視，連喜帖都是他們親自設計的。
examples.pinyin: Dài xiǎojiě de fùmǔ duì hūnlǐ xiāngdāng zhòngshì, lián xǐtiě dōu shì tāmen qīnzì shèjì de.
examples.english: Miss Dai's parents place great importance on the wedding; even the wedding invitations were designed by them personally.

examples.chinese: 這個背包在設計上沒什麼特色，只是印了某位明星隨手畫的圖，沒想到就要賣上萬元，實在有點兒誇張。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bēibāo zài shèjì shàng méi shénme tèsè, zhǐshì yìnle mǒu wèi míngxīng suíshǒu huà de tú, méi xiǎngdào jiù yào mài shàng wàn yuán, shízài yǒudiǎnr kuāzhāng.
examples.english: This backpack has nothing distinctive in its design; it just has a picture casually drawn by some celebrity printed on it. I never expected it to sell for over ten thousand dollars—that's really a bit outrageous.

examples.chinese: 那只鑽石戒指的設計極有特色，很適合當作婚戒(wedding ring)。
examples.pinyin: Nà zhī zuànshí jièzhǐ de shèjì jí yǒu tèsè, hěn shìhé dāngzuò hūnjiè.
examples.english: The design of that diamond ring is extremely distinctive; it is very suitable to serve as a wedding ring.

examples.chinese: 這種化妝品是針對東方人的皮膚設計的，在臺灣賣得很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng huàzhuāngpǐn shì zhēnduì dōngfāngrén de pífū shèjì de, zài Táiwān mài de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: This kind of cosmetics is designed specifically for Eastern people's skin, and sells very well in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 設計師利用上電視的機會，展示他今年設計的服裝。
examples.pinyin: Shèjìshī lìyòng shàng diànshì de jīhuì, zhǎnshì tā jīnnián shèjì de fúzhuāng.
examples.english: The designer used the opportunity of appearing on TV to display the clothing he designed this year.

examples.chinese: 這幅設計圖畫得很仔細，畫圖的人應該相當細心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú shèjì tú huà de hěn zǐxì, huà tú de rén yīnggāi xiāngdāng xìxīn.
examples.english: This design drawing is drawn very carefully; the person who drew it must be quite meticulous.

examples.chinese: 每面國旗都代表一個國家，而且設計上都具有獨特的意義。
examples.pinyin: Měi miàn guóqí dōu dàibiǎo yī ge guójiā, érqiě shèjì shàng dōu jùyǒu dútè de yìyì.
examples.english: Every national flag represents a country, and each has a unique meaning in its design.

examples.chinese: 為了吸引人才，廣告企業提供獎金給優秀的設計師。
examples.pinyin: Wèile xīyǐn réncái, guǎnggào qǐyè tígōng jiǎngjīn gěi yōuxiù de shèjìshī.
examples.english: In order to attract talent, advertising companies offer bonuses to outstanding designers.

items.wordHook: Combining 設(build) and 計(calculate): 設計 means design.

examples.chinese: 台灣有各式各樣的小吃，其中最吸引我的是蚵仔煎。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yǒu gèshìgèyàng de xiǎochī, qízhōng zuì xīyǐn wǒ de shì kēzǎijiān.
examples.english: Taiwan has all kinds of snacks, among which the one that attracts me most is oyster omelet.

examples.chinese: 華語文中心的學生都很會跳舞，其中跳得最好的是非洲學生。
examples.pinyin: Huáyǔwén zhōngxīn de xuésheng dōu hěn huì tiàowǔ, qízhōng tiào de zuì hǎo de shì Fēizhōu xuésheng.
examples.english: The students at the Mandarin Learning Center are all very good at dancing; among them, the one who dances the best is the African student.

examples.chinese: 這班學生多數都會說法國話，其中有半數是從歐洲來的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bān xuéshēng duōshù dōu huì shuō Fǎguóhuà, qízhōng yǒu bànshù shì cóng Ōuzhōu lái de.
examples.english: Most of the students in this class can speak French; half of them are from Europe.

examples.chinese: 這臺食品加工設備的構造相當複雜，其中約三分之一的零件還是由國外進口。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái shípǐn jiāgōng shèbèi de gòuzào xiāngdāng fùzá, qízhōng yuē sān fēn zhī yī de língjiàn hái shì yóu guówài jìnkǒu.
examples.english: The structure of this food processing equipment is quite complex, and about one third of its parts are still imported from abroad.

items.wordHook: Combining 中(middle) and 餐(eat): 中餐 means Chinese cuisine.

examples.chinese: 軍人用卡車把食物和生活用品送到災區，發給需要的民眾。
examples.pinyin: Jūnrén yòng kǎchē bǎ shíwù hé shēnghuó yòngpǐn sòng dào zāiqū, fā gěi xūyào de mínzhòng.
examples.english: Soldiers used trucks to deliver food and daily necessities to the disaster area and distribute them to the people in need.

examples.chinese: 這個紀念堂是為了紀念那些為國家犧牲生命的軍人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jìniàntáng shì wèile jìniàn nàxiē wèi guójiā xīshēng shēngmìng de jūnrén.
examples.english: This memorial hall is to commemorate those soldiers who sacrificed their lives for the country.

examples.chinese: 打仗期間，許多軍人為國家犧牲了寶貴的生命，也給家人留下了痛苦的記憶。
examples.pinyin: Dǎzhàng qījiān, xǔduō jūnrén wèi guójiā xīshēngle bǎoguì de shēngmìng, yě gěi jiārén liúxiàle tòngkǔ de jìyì.
examples.english: During the war, many soldiers sacrificed their precious lives for the country, and also left painful memories for their families.

examples.chinese: 這場大地震發生後不久，軍人就立刻趕到了災區，協助救災工作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dà dìzhèn fāshēng hòu bùjiǔ, jūnrén jiù lìkè gǎndàole zāiqū, xiézhù jiùzāi gōngzuò.
examples.english: Shortly after this major earthquake occurred, soldiers immediately rushed to the disaster area to assist with disaster relief work.

examples.chinese: 到地震災區救災的軍人們，這幾天忙得連一頓飯都沒辦法好好地吃。
examples.pinyin: Dào dìzhèn zāiqū jiùzāi de jūnrénmen, zhè jǐ tiān máng de lián yí dùn fàn dōu méi bànfǎ hǎohǎo de chī.
examples.english: The soldiers who went to the earthquake disaster area for rescue have been so busy these days that they couldn't even properly eat a single meal.

examples.chinese: 從小時候起，他的第一志願就是當一位保護國家的軍人。
examples.pinyin: Cóng xiǎoshíhou qǐ, tā de dì-yī zhìyuàn jiùshì dāng yī wèi bǎohù guójiā de jūnrén.
examples.english: Since childhood, his first aspiration has been to be a soldier who protects the country.

examples.chinese: 軍人接到任務時，不管多麼危險都得努力完成。
examples.pinyin: Jūnrén jiēdào rènwu shí, bùguǎn duōme wēixiǎn dōu děi nǔlì wánchéng.
examples.english: When soldiers receive a mission, no matter how dangerous it is, they must strive to complete it.

items.wordHook: Serving in 軍(army) as a dedicated 人(person): 軍人 means soldier.

examples.chinese: 這個路口很危險，經常發生車禍。
examples.pinyin: Zhège lùkǒu hěn wēixiǎn, jīngcháng fāshēng chēhuò.
examples.english: This intersection is very dangerous; car accidents often happen here.

examples.chinese: 那個人喝了酒還開車，結果造成嚴重的車禍，害兩個人不幸死了，真可惡！
examples.pinyin: Nàge rén hē le jiǔ hái kāichē, jiéguǒ zàochéng yánzhòng de chēhuò, hài liǎng ge rén bùxìng sǐ le, zhēn kěwù!
examples.english: That person drank alcohol and still drove, resulting in a serious car accident that caused two people to die tragically; how detestable!

examples.chinese: 在那場車禍中，那個孩子失去了父母，家裡只剩下他一個人，大家都很同情他。
examples.pinyin: Zài nà chǎng chēhuò zhōng, nàge háizi shīqù le fùmǔ, jiālǐ zhǐ shèng xià tā yī ge rén, dàjiā dōu hěn tóngqíng tā.
examples.english: In that car accident, that child lost his parents, and he was the only one left in the family; everyone sympathized with him.

examples.chinese: 黃先生的腳因為車禍受了很嚴重的傷，醫生建議他不要做太激烈的運動。這場網球比賽打得很激烈，已經打了五個小時了，還不知道誰輸誰贏。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng de jiǎo yīnwèi chēhuò shòule hěn yánzhòng de shāng, yīshēng jiànyì tā búyào zuò tài jīliè de yùndòng. Zhè chǎng wǎngqiú bǐsài dǎ de hěn jīliè, yǐjīng dǎle wǔ ge xiǎoshí le, hái bù zhīdào shéi shū shéi yíng.
examples.english: Mr. Huang's foot was seriously injured in a car accident; the doctor advised him not to do overly intense exercise. This tennis match is being played very fiercely; it has already been played for five hours, and it is still unknown who will lose and who will win.

examples.chinese: 今天上午學校附近發生了車禍，經過警察處理後，現在交通已恢復正常。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shàngwǔ xuéxiào fùjìn fāshēng le chēhuò, jīngguò jǐngchá chǔlǐ hòu, xiànzài jiāotōng yǐ huīfù zhèngcháng.
examples.english: This morning a car accident occurred near the school. After the police handled it, traffic has now returned to normal.

examples.chinese: 路邊的攝影機錄到了房先生發生車禍的經過，讓警察順利抓到了害他受傷的人。
examples.pinyin: Lùbiān de shèyǐngjī lù dào le Fáng xiānsheng fāshēng chēhuò de jīngguò, ràng jǐngchá shùnlì zhuā dào le hài tā shòushāng de rén.
examples.english: The roadside camera recorded the course of Mr. Fang's car accident, allowing the police to smoothly catch the person who injured him.

examples.chinese: 連警察都證明這個車禍是段老闆喝醉造成的，可是他仍然不肯承認。
examples.pinyin: Lián jǐngchá dōu zhèngmíng zhège chēhuò shì Duàn lǎobǎn hē zuì zàochéng de, kěshì tā réngrán bù kěn chéngrèn.
examples.english: Even the police proved that this car accident was caused by Boss Duan getting drunk, but he still refuses to admit it.

examples.chinese: 根據車禍調查的結果，保險公司及對方應各賠我十萬元。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù chēhuò diàochá de jiéguǒ, bǎoxiǎn gōngsī jí duìfāng yīng gè péi wǒ shí wàn yuán.
examples.english: According to the results of the car accident investigation, the insurance company and the other party should each compensate me one hundred thousand dollars.

examples.chinese: 開車時萬一發生車禍，千萬要冷靜，以免情況更嚴重。
examples.pinyin: Kāichē shí wànyī fāshēng chēhuò, qiānwàn yào lěngjìng, yǐmiǎn qíngkuàng gèng yánzhòng.
examples.english: If a car accident happens while driving, one must by all means stay calm, so as to avoid the situation becoming more serious.

examples.chinese: 最近酒後開車的車禍新聞越來越多，政府得好好處罰這些人。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn jiǔhòu kāichē de chēhuò xīnwén yuè lái yuè duō, zhèngfǔ děi hǎohǎo chǔfá zhèxiē rén.
examples.english: Recently there has been more and more news of car accidents from drunk driving; the government must properly punish these people.

examples.chinese: 張小姐很膽小，看到車禍現場有人流了很多血，當場就昏倒了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiǎojiě hěn dǎnxiǎo, kàn dào chēhuò xiànchǎng yǒu rén liú le hěn duō xiě, dāngchǎng jiù hūndǎo le.
examples.english: Miss Zhang is very timid; when she saw someone bleeding a lot at the car accident scene, she fainted on the spot.

examples.chinese: 小張出車禍雖然賠了很多錢，不過好在人沒事。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng chū chēhuò suīrán péi le hěn duō qián, bùguò hǎozài rén méi shì.
examples.english: Although Xiao Zhang had a car accident and paid a lot of money, fortunately no one was hurt.

examples.chinese: 「總統」是國家最高領導人，他領導全國民眾往前走，讓國家越來越進步。
examples.pinyin: 「Zǒngtǒng」 shì guójiā zuìgāo lǐngdǎorén, tā lǐngdǎo quánguó mínzhòng wǎng qián zǒu, ràng guójiā yuè lái yuè jìnbù.
examples.english: The "president" is the highest leader of the country; he leads the people of the whole nation forward, making the country more and more progressive.

examples.chinese: 這支手錶是我過世的爺爺留給我的，對我來說具有特別的意義。我的老闆具有獨特的領導魅力， 員工都願意跟著他努力工作。
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhè zhī shǒubiǎo shì wǒ guòshì de yéye liú gěi wǒ de, duì wǒ lái shuō jùyǒu tèbié de yìyì. 2. Wǒ de lǎobǎn jùyǒu dútè de lǐngdǎo mèilì, yuángōng dōu yuànyì gēnzhe tā nǔlì gōngzuò.
examples.english: 1. This watch was left to me by my late grandfather; to me, it has special significance. 2. My boss has a unique leadership charisma; the employees are all willing to work hard following him.

examples.chinese: 警察抓到小偷後就把他帶到警察局，關了起來。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá zhuādào xiǎotōu hòu jiù bǎ tā dàidào jǐngchájú, guān le qǐlái.
examples.english: After the police caught the thief, they took him to the police station and locked him up.

examples.chinese: A:我對何小姐是真心的，為什麼她一直不肯接受呢？ B:你應該更關心她、更體貼她，讓她知道你是真心愛她的。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ duì Hé xiǎojiě shì zhēnxīn de, wèishénme tā yìzhí bù kěn jiēshòu ne? B: Nǐ yīnggāi gèng guānxīn tā, gèng tǐtiē tā, ràng tā zhīdào nǐ shì zhēnxīn ài tā de.
examples.english: A: I am sincere toward Miss He; why does she keep refusing to accept me? B: You should care about her more and be more considerate of her, so she knows you truly love her.

examples.chinese: 這個銷售計畫很好，不過得先解決相關費用和推銷人員等現實問題。A:如果現在有一千萬從天上掉下來，那該多好啊！ B:你別再做夢了，趕快回到現實吧！
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoshòu jìhuà hěn hǎo, bùguò děi xiān jiějué xiāngguān fèiyòng hé tuīxiāo rényuán děng xiànshí wèntí. A: Rúguǒ xiànzài yǒu yīqiān wàn cóng tiānshàng diào xiàlái, nà gāi duō hǎo a! B: Nǐ bié zài zuòmèng le, gǎnkuài huídào xiànshí ba!
examples.english: This sales plan is good, but we must first solve realistic problems such as related costs and sales personnel. A: If ten million were to fall from the sky right now, how great that would be! B: Stop dreaming and quickly return to reality!

examples.chinese: 老師先把跟課程相關的學習資料上傳到雲端，讓學生預習。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī xiān bǎ gēn kèchéng xiāngguān de xuéxí zīliào shàngchuán dào yúnduān, ràng xuéshēng yùxí.
examples.english: The teacher first uploads the course-related learning materials to the cloud for students to preview.

examples.chinese: 陸教授在自己的網站上發表有關教學和研究的成果，相當值得參考。
examples.pinyin: Lù jiàoshòu zài zìjǐ de wǎngzhàn shàng fābiǎo yǒuguān jiàoxué hé yánjiū de chéngguǒ, xiāngdāng zhídé cānkǎo.
examples.english: Professor Lu publishes the results of teaching and research on his own website, which are quite worth referring to.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，面試時要準備的相關文件包括個人基本資料、畢業證書等等。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, miànshì shí yào zhǔnbèi de xiāngguān wénjiàn bāokuò gèrén jīběn zīliào, bìyè zhèngshū děngděng.
examples.english: Generally speaking, the relevant documents to prepare for an interview include basic personal information, graduation certificate, and so on.

examples.chinese: 有關這場火災的詳細情況，等調查結果出來以後，市長會向民眾報告。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuguān zhè chǎng huǒzāi de xiángxì qíngkuàng, děng diàochá jiéguǒ chūlái yǐhòu, shìzhǎng huì xiàng mínzhòng bàogào.
examples.english: Regarding the detailed situation of this fire, after the investigation results come out, the mayor will report to the public.

examples.chinese: 弟弟因為明天要去大學面試，緊張得整個晚上都睡不好。為了準備這次的面試，我看了很多相關資料，還不斷地練習面試時跟主管的對話。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi yīnwèi míngtiān yào qù dàxué miànshì, jǐnzhāng de zhěnggè wǎnshang dōu shuì bù hǎo. Wèile zhǔnbèi zhè cì de miànshì, wǒ kàn le hěnduō xiāngguān zīliào, hái búduàn de liànxí miànshì shí gēn zhǔguǎn de duìhuà.
examples.english: Because my younger brother is going to a university interview tomorrow, he was so nervous that he couldn't sleep well the whole night. In order to prepare for this interview, I read a lot of related information and also constantly practiced the conversation with the manager during the interview.

examples.chinese: 那班飛機因為天氣的關係，沒辦法準時抵達。總統抵達新聞說明會的現場前，安全人員得先確認記者的資料，還得檢查他們的背包。
examples.pinyin: Nà bān fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì de guānxi, méi bànfǎ zhǔnshí dǐdá. Zǒngtǒng dǐdá xīnwén shuōmínghuì de xiànchǎng qián, ānquán rényuán děi xiān quèrèn jìzhě de zīliào, hái děi jiǎnchá tāmen de bēibāo.
examples.english: That flight could not arrive on time because of the weather. Before the president arrived at the press conference site, security personnel had to first confirm the reporters' information and also check their backpacks.

examples.chinese: 前幾天因為颱風的關係，造成部分地區嚴重淹水，許多蔬果的價格都變高了。
examples.pinyin: Qián jǐ tiān yīnwèi táifēng de guānxì, zàochéng bùfèn dìqū yánzhòng yānshuǐ, xǔduō shūguǒ de jiàgé dōu biàn gāo le.
examples.english: A few days ago, because of the typhoon, some areas suffered severe flooding, and the prices of many vegetables and fruits have gone up.

examples.chinese: 簡老闆因為生意的關係，經常接觸越南人，相當了解兩國之間工作習慣的差異。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎn lǎobǎn yīnwèi shēngyì de guānxì, jīngcháng jiēchù Yuènánrén, xiāngdāng liǎojiě liǎng guó zhījiān gōngzuò xíguàn de chāyì.
examples.english: Boss Jian, because of business, frequently contacts Vietnamese people and quite understands the differences in working habits between the two countries.

examples.chinese: A:對不起，你的杯子被我打破了，我不是故意的。 B:沒關係！還好你沒受傷。
examples.pinyin: A: Duìbuqǐ, nǐ de bēizi bèi wǒ dǎpò le, wǒ bùshì gùyì de. B: Méi guānxi! Háohǎo nǐ méi shòushāng.
examples.english: A: Sorry, your cup was broken by me; I didn't do it on purpose. B: It's okay! Good thing you're not hurt.

examples.chinese: 這堂課的內容跟文化有關，所以老師把教學重心放在介紹各國的文化特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè táng kè de nèiróng gēn wénhuà yǒuguān, suǒyǐ lǎoshī bǎ jiàoxué zhòngxīn fàng zài jièshào gè guó de wénhuà tèsè.
examples.english: The content of this class is related to culture, so the teacher put the teaching focus on introducing the cultural characteristics of various countries.

examples.chinese: 好幾個人都看到他跟這場火災有關，他不但不承認，反而說是鄰居做的。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo jǐ ge rén dōu kàndào tā gēn zhè chǎng huǒzāi yǒuguān, tā búdàn bù chéngrèn, fǎn'ér shuō shì línjū zuò de.
examples.english: Several people saw that he was connected to this fire; not only did he not admit it, but instead he said the neighbor did it.

examples.chinese: 真正的朋友會幫助你、關心你，是絕對不會傷害你的。青少年常因為不了解而誤會父母的教育方式，或許等他們長大了，就能真正明白了。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de péngyǒu huì bāngzhù nǐ, guānxīn nǐ, shì juéduì bù huì shānghài nǐ de. Qīngshàonián cháng yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér wùhuì fùmǔ de jiàoyù fāngshì, huòxǔ děng tāmen zhǎngdà le, jiù néng zhēnzhèng míngbai le.
examples.english: True friends will help you and care about you; they will absolutely not hurt you. Teenagers often misunderstand their parents' way of education because they don't understand; perhaps when they grow up, they will truly understand.

examples.chinese: 因為工作太忙的關係，夏小姐已經有一段時間沒上街購物了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng de guānxì, Xià xiǎojiě yǐjīng yǒu yī duàn shíjiān méi shàngjiē gòuwù le.
examples.english: Because she is too busy with work, Miss Xia has not gone out shopping for some time.

examples.chinese: 有人說，男人的話題常跟政治有關，女人的話題不是名牌包、就是化妝品。你同意嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō, nánrén de huàtí cháng gēn zhèngzhì yǒuguān, nǚrén de huàtí bùshì míngpái bāo, jiùshì huàzhuāngpǐn. Nǐ tóngyì ma?
examples.english: Some people say that men's topics are often related to politics, and women's topics are either designer bags or cosmetics. Do you agree?

examples.chinese: A:聽說明天的會跟新商品的推銷計畫有關，你要參加嗎？ B:我是公司的安全人員，這個會應該跟我無關。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō míngtiān de huì gēn xīn shāngpǐn de tuīxiāo jìhuà yǒuguān, nǐ yào cānjiā ma? B: Wǒ shì gōngsī de ānquán rényuán, zhège huì yīnggāi gēn wǒ wúguān.
examples.english: A: I heard that tomorrow's meeting is related to the new product promotion plan; are you going to attend? B: I am the company's security personnel; this meeting should be unrelated to me.

examples.chinese: 能不能騎自行車完成環島的行程，跟耐心有關，跟聰明不聰明無關。
examples.pinyin: Néng bù néng qí zìxíngchē wánchéng huándǎo de xíngchéng, gēn nàixīn yǒuguān, gēn cōngmíng bù cōngmíng wúguān.
examples.english: Whether you can complete a round-the-island trip by bicycle is related to patience, and unrelated to whether you are smart or not.

examples.chinese: 今天藝術系的學生要在學校的禮堂，演出跟十二生肖有關的故事。 那名演員很厲害，在那部電影裡一個人演出三個角色。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān yìshù xì de xuéshēng yào zài xuéxiào de lǐtáng, yǎnchū gēn shí'èr shēngxiào yǒuguān de gùshì. Nà míng yǎnyuán hěn lìhài, zài nà bù diànyǐng lǐ yīgè rén yǎnchū sān gè juésè.
examples.english: Today the art department students are going to perform a story related to the twelve zodiac signs in the school auditorium. That actor is very impressive; in that movie, he performed three roles by himself.

examples.chinese: 這個我覺得最難忘的回憶應該是跟「第一次」相關的經驗，比如第一次戀愛、第一次當背包客等等。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wǒ juéde zuì nánwàng de huíyì yīnggāi shì gēn “dì yī cì” xiāngguān de jīngyàn, bǐrú dì yī cì liàn'ài, dì yī cì dāng bèibāokè děngděng.
examples.english: The most memorable memory for me, I think, should be experiences related to 'first times,' such as first love, being a backpacker for the first time, and so on.

examples.chinese: 發生大地震後，民眾都發揮愛心，主動提供救災的相關用品給災民。
examples.pinyin: Fāshēng dà dìzhèn hòu, mínzhòng dōu fāhuī àixīn, zhǔdòng tígōng jiùzāi de xiāngguān yòngpǐn gěi zāimín.
examples.english: After the major earthquake, people showed compassion and proactively provided disaster-relief related supplies to the victims.

examples.chinese: 因為水災的關係，許多學校沒辦法正常上課，甚至連便利商店都關了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi shuǐzāi de guānxi, xǔduō xuéxiào méi bànfǎ zhèngcháng shàngkè, shènzhì lián biànlì shāngdiàn dōu guān le.
examples.english: Because of the flood, many schools cannot have classes normally; even convenience stores have closed.

examples.chinese: 醫生說你肩膀疼的原因，是因為長時間打電腦的關係。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō nǐ jiānbǎng téng de yuányīn, shì yīnwèi cháng shíjiān dǎ diànnǎo de guānxì.
examples.english: The doctor said the reason your shoulder hurts is because of using the computer for a long time.

examples.chinese: 黃教授不僅知識豐富、上課認真，還很關心學生，大家都很尊敬他。
examples.pinyin: Huáng jiàoshòu bùjǐn zhīshì fēngfù, shàngkè rènzhēn, hái hěn guānxīn xuéshēng, dàjiā dōu hěn zūnjìng tā.
examples.english: Professor Huang not only has rich knowledge and teaches seriously, but also cares about students very much; everyone respects him greatly.

examples.chinese: 金小姐穿上這件淺色的上衣， 看起來更年輕、更有精神了。這個衣櫃有點兒淺，這件厚大衣掛不進去，就算掛進去了， 門也關不起來。
examples.pinyin: Jīn xiǎojiě chuān shàng zhè jiàn qiǎnsè de shàngyī, kàn qǐlái gèng niánqīng, gèng yǒu jīngshén le. Zhège yīguì yǒudiǎnr qiǎn, zhè jiàn hòu dàyī guà bù jìnqù, jiùsuàn guà jìnqù le, mén yě guān bù qǐlái.
examples.english: When Miss Jin puts on this light-colored top, she looks younger and more energetic. This wardrobe is a bit shallow; this thick coat can't hang inside, and even if it could, the door wouldn't close.

examples.chinese: 小李今天看起來比較瘦，可能是因為穿了深色衣服的關係。我妹妹剛學會游泳，就想游到水很深的地方，我覺得太危險了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ jīntiān kàn qǐlái bǐjiào shòu, kěnéng shì yīnwèi chuān le shēnsè yīfu de guānxi. Wǒ mèimei gāng xuéhuì yóuyǒng, jiù xiǎng yóu dào shuǐ hěn shēn de dìfāng, wǒ juéde tài wēixiǎn le.
examples.english: Xiao Li looks thinner today; it might be because he wore dark-colored clothes. My younger sister just learned to swim and already wants to swim to a place where the water is very deep; I think it's too dangerous.

examples.chinese: 因為最近太多人感冒的關係，來上課的同學變少了，我們班不過十個人，就有五個人請假 。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi zuìjìn tài duō rén gǎnmào de guānxi, lái shàngkè de tóngxué biàn shǎo le, wǒmen bān búguò shí ge rén, jiù yǒu wǔ ge rén qǐngjià.
examples.english: Because too many people have caught colds recently, fewer classmates are coming to class; in our class of only ten people, five have asked for leave.

examples.chinese: 大華為了參加唱歌比賽，除了每天不斷地練習，也把自己唱的歌錄下來聽一聽，希望能唱得更好。雖然陸先生這幾年工作機會不斷，但是因為身體不好的關係一直沒辦法去上班。
examples.pinyin: Dàhuá wèile cānjiā chànggē bǐsài, chúle měitiān bùduàn de liànxí, yě bǎ zìjǐ chàng de gē lù xiàlái tīng yī tīng, xīwàng néng chàng de gèng hǎo. Suīrán Lù xiānsheng zhè jǐ nián gōngzuò jīhuì bùduàn, dànshì yīnwèi shēntǐ bù hǎo de guānxi yīzhí méi bànfǎ qù shàngbān.
examples.english: In order to participate in the singing competition, Dahua not only practices continuously every day, but also records his own singing to listen to, hoping to sing better. Although Mr. Lu has had continuous job opportunities these past few years, because of poor health he has never been able to go to work.

examples.chinese: A:中明，請問學校圖書館幾點關？ B:你不知道啊？圖書館晚上九點關 。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhōngmíng, qǐngwèn xuéxiào túshūguǎn jǐ diǎn guān? B: Nǐ bù zhīdào a? Túshūguǎn wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn guān.
examples.english: A: Zhongming, may I ask what time the school library closes? B: You don't know? The library closes at 9 p.m.

examples.chinese: A:對不起？ B:沒關係。
examples.pinyin: A: Duìbuqǐ? B: Méi guānxi.
examples.english: A: Sorry? B: It's okay.

examples.chinese: 學校的圖書館早上八點開，晚上九點關。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de túshūguǎn zǎoshang bā diǎn kāi, wǎnshang jiǔ diǎn guān.
examples.english: The school library opens at 8 a.m. and closes at 9 p.m.

examples.chinese: 沒關係，我們可以下個週末再來看。對了，妳要買鞋子吧？
examples.pinyin: Méiguānxi, wǒmen kěyǐ xià ge zhōumò zài lái kàn. Duìle, nǐ yào mǎi xiézi ba?
examples.english: It’s okay; we can come again next weekend. By the way, you want to buy shoes, don’t you?

examples.chinese: 鞋子都在一樓，我們到樓下去吧！九點了，百貨公司快要關了。
examples.pinyin: Xiézi dōu zài yì lóu, wǒmen dào lóuxià qù ba! Jiǔ diǎn le, bǎihuògōngsī kuàiyào guān le.
examples.english: All the shoes are on the first floor. Let’s go downstairs. It’s 9:00; the department store is closing soon.

examples.chinese: 這次會議的主題跟銷售新產品有關，所以廣告部門的人員得參加。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì de zhǔtí gēn xiāoshòu xīn chǎnpǐn yǒuguān, suǒyǐ guǎnggào bùmén de rényuán děi cānjiā.
examples.english: The theme of this meeting is related to selling new products, so the personnel from the advertising department must attend.

examples.chinese: 國家跟國家之間的外交關係很重要，這方面的工作是總統負責的。
examples.pinyin: Guójiā gēn guójiā zhījiān de wàijiāo guānxì hěn zhòngyào, zhè fāngmiàn de gōngzuò shì zǒngtǒng fùzé de.
examples.english: Diplomatic relations between countries are very important; work in this area is the president's responsibility.

examples.chinese: 因為強烈颱風的關係，機場已經關了，等風小一點才會再開放。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi qiángliè táifēng de guānxì, jīchǎng yǐjīng guān le, děng fēng xiǎo yīdiǎn cái huì zài kāifàng.
examples.english: Because of the strong typhoon, the airport has already closed; it will open again only after the wind gets a little weaker.

examples.chinese: 歷史系的李教授最近經常接受記者的訪問，因此變得很有名。那名記者為了訪問總統外交、貿易等方面的問題，閱讀了許多相關的資料。
examples.pinyin: Lìshǐ xì de Lǐ jiàoshòu zuìjìn jīngcháng jiēshòu jìzhě de fǎngwèn, yīncǐ biàn de hěn yǒumíng. Nà míng jìzhě wèile fǎngwèn zǒngtǒng wàijiāo, màoyì děng fāngmiàn de wèntí, yuèdú le xǔduō xiāngguān de zīliào.
examples.english: Professor Li from the History Department has recently often been interviewed by reporters, and therefore has become very famous. That reporter, in order to interview the president about questions on diplomacy, trade, and other aspects, read a lot of related materials.

examples.chinese: 飲食與健康有密切的關係，所以人人都應該按時吃三餐。
examples.pinyin: Yǐnshí yǔ jiànkāng yǒu mìqiè de guānxì, suǒyǐ rénrén dōu yīnggāi ànshí chī sān cān.
examples.english: Diet and health have a close relationship, so everyone should eat three meals on time.

items.wordHook: a 門(door) woven of 𢆶(silk threads) and 丱(twin posts) stands shut → the gate will 關(close).

examples.chinese: 這次茶會主要是為了招待客戶，同時透過這個茶會來發表公司的新產品。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì cháhuì zhǔyào shì wèile zhāodài kèhù, tóngshí tòuguò zhège cháhuì lái fābiǎo gōngsī de xīn chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: This tea party is mainly to entertain clients, and at the same time, through this tea party, to launch the company's new products.

examples.chinese: A:喲，你今天怎麼穿得這麼帥？ B:下午要參加公司茶會，得穿得正式一些？ A:那下次跟我約會時，也要這麼穿呦！
examples.pinyin: A: Yō, nǐ jīntiān zěnme chuān de zhème shuài? B: Xiàwǔ yào cānjiā gōngsī cháhuì, děi chuān de zhèngshì yīxiē? A: Nà xià cì gēn wǒ yuēhuì shí, yě yào zhème chuān yo!
examples.english: A: Oh! How come you're dressed so handsome today? B: I have to attend the company tea party this afternoon, so I need to dress a bit formally? A: Then next time you go on a date with me, you should dress like this too!

examples.chinese: 今天兩小時的會議，因為要討論的事增加而延長了三十分。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān liǎng xiǎoshí de huìyì, yīnwèi yào tǎolùn de shì zēngjiā ér yáncháng le sānshí fēn.
examples.english: Today's two-hour meeting was extended by thirty minutes because the matters to discuss increased.

examples.chinese: 當你面臨困難或挑戰時，也正是表現個人智慧與能力的最佳時刻。
examples.pinyin: Dāng nǐ miànlín kùnnán huò tiǎozhàn shí, yě zhèng shì biǎoxiàn gèrén zhìhuì yǔ nénglì de zuì jiā shíkè.
examples.english: When you face difficulties or challenges, it is also exactly the best moment to demonstrate personal wisdom and ability.

examples.chinese: 李伯伯對做家事有很多妙主意，因此附近的鄰居常向他請教。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ bóbo duì zuò jiāshì yǒu hěn duō miào zhǔyi, yīncǐ fùjìn de línjū cháng xiàng tā qǐngjiào.
examples.english: Uncle Li has many clever ideas for doing housework, so neighbors nearby often ask him for advice.

examples.chinese: 當你願意開放自己的心時， 你所見的世界也會更加地美妙。
examples.pinyin: Dāng nǐ yuànyì kāifàng zìjǐ de xīn shí, nǐ suǒ jiàn de shìjiè yě huì gèngjiā de měimiào.
examples.english: When you are willing to open your heart, the world you see will also become even more wonderful.

items.wordHook: a 女(woman) holds her 子(child) close to her → all is 好(good).
希(hope) + 望(to look forward) → looking forward in hope: 希望 means to hope.
華(Chinese) + 語(words) → the words of Chinese, meaning the Chinese language.
